entities.name: Zdenka Kramplová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdenka Kramplová was Minister of agriculture of Slovakia from 27 November 2007 until 18 August 2008 and former Foreign Minister of Slovakia from 1997 to 1998. She is a former member of the People's Party – Movement for a Democratic Slovakia. Mrs. Kramplová studied agriculture in Plovdiv, Bulgaria (1976–1981).
